extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Now, what matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The call was focused on a Medicare Part D plan.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Dana! You effectively followed all the necessary steps and ensured the customer understood the disclaimer before discussing the benefits. One area for improvement is to ensure the customer signs the Scope of Appointment immediately after sending it, to avoid any delays.
